faq.heroSub: Answers to your most important questions
faq.ctaText: Our support team is happy to help.

items.q: Which credit cards does Finanzkredit offer?
items.a: We offer Classic, Gold and Platinum Visa credit cards. All cards are accepted worldwide, and our premium cards come with cashback and extra benefits.

items.q: How do I apply for a credit card?
items.a: You apply directly in your online banking or the app. Once approved, your card is delivered by post within 3–5 working days.

items.q: What should I do if my card is lost?
items.a: Block your card immediately via the app or on 0800 123 456 7. A replacement card will be sent to you within 2 working days.
There are no foreign transaction fees on our Plus and Premium accounts. The Basic account is charged a fee of 1.5% of the transaction amount.

items.q: Which types of loans does Finanzkredit offer?
items.a: We offer real estate loans (from 3.5% p.a.), car loans (from 4.2% p.a.) and personal loans (from 5.9% p.a.). All loans can be calculated in advance with the simulator.

items.q: How quickly will I receive a loan decision?
items.a: For personal and car loans you usually receive a decision within 24 hours. For real estate loans the review takes 3–5 working days.

items.q: Can I repay my loan early?
items.a: Yes, early repayment is possible at any time. No early repayment fees apply to personal loans.

items.q: Which documents do I need for a loan application?
items.a: You need a valid ID, recent payslips (last 3 months) and bank statements (last 3 months).

items.q: How long does a SEPA transfer take?
items.a: Standard SEPA transfers are executed within 1 working day. With SEPA Instant, transfers are possible within 10 seconds.
The standard daily limit is €50,000. For higher amounts you can contact us to agree on individual limits.
Yes, we offer SWIFT transfers to more than 150 countries. Processing time is 1–5 working days, depending on the destination country.

items.q: How do I set up a standing order?
items.a: Standing orders can easily be set up via the app or online banking. Go to "Transfers" > "Create standing order".

items.q: How secure is my data at Finanzkredit?
items.a: We use 256-bit SSL encryption and two-factor authentication, and we are ISO 27001 certified. Your deposits are protected up to €100,000.

items.q: What should I do if I notice suspicious activity?
items.a: Block your account immediately via the app and contact our 24/7 security emergency support on 0800 987 654 3.
